_comment_rewrites: SPA fallback. App.jsx routes client-side (isAdminPath() opens the Admin Panel on /admin), but there is no /admin file on disk, so without this a direct visit or refresh returned Vercel's own 404 instead of the app - confirmed live on 2026-08-22. Vercel checks the filesystem BEFORE applying rewrites, so /assets/* still resolve normally; /api/ is excluded explicitly so a missing function returns a real 404 rather than silently serving HTML to a fetch().
